equity.equity_measurement: Race/ethnicity describes 199 male cases with data; education, income and insurance describe 64 male interview respondents; 35 of 106 selected cases could not be contacted.

notes: An outbreak report with counts, percentages, a rate comparison of MSM with other groups, and a PFGE pattern comparison, with no p-values or models. The MSM rate contrast is read as a transmission category rather than sexual orientation, so equity is level 1, and a level 2 reading is given as the alternative. The PFGE comparison is the only laboratory method recorded because it produces the compared proportions.
view_issues: The case period is June--December 2000 in one sentence and May--December 2000 in another, and the age threshold is over 15 years in the footnote but over 18 years for interviews.
